baseline.scope: Only the eight named paths; other existing dirty work is preserved.

changes: Explicit Cancel is available in offer compose and review; Edit offer remains separate. Dismissal preserves amount, successful confirmation clears it.
The existing same-turn mutation ref blocks close during dispatch; disabled controls and existing submission guards prevent duplicate actions. Existing RPC and account checks unchanged.
Offer dialogs opt in to visualViewport height/offset updates with bounded scrollable layout; ordinary dialogs remain unchanged.

Admin Lights out joins existing modes, inherits both dark token groups, uses black workspace surfaces, and persists/restores through the existing cookie/server layout. Member-web Lights out was already present and unchanged.

verification.harness: Actual TSX component functions, effects and event handlers transpiled by installed TypeScript; controlled React/DOM/viewport/auth/RPC hosts. Actual admin server layout executes with controlled cookie/font dependencies.
verification.browser: Not run: prior Chromium and system browser executables are absent; no download or build initiated.
verification.typescriptProjectGate: Not run in this bounded restoration.

reactReview: Viewport effect depends only on open and keyboardSafe; no setState or render loop.
Listeners exist only while an opted-in dialog is open; scroll is passive and both listeners/styles are removed.
No new fetches, dependencies, server auth changes or RPC retries.
The existing mutation ref provides synchronous submission ownership; dialog close callback checks it.
Admin cookie is accepted by the server layout on initial render, and useSyncExternalStore retains the existing subscription model.
limits: Not byte-identical recovery of the earlier missing patch or evidence.
Controlled hosts do not establish physical keyboard, browser focus behavior, CSS geometry, or device appearance acceptance.
No native files, production backend operations, build, CI dispatch, deployment, or reference mutations.
